title: Bestiary

{{Infobox/Generic|image=Bestiary Icon.png|title=Bestiary}} The '''Bestiary''' is a repository for data on [[Mobs]]. It tracks the player's kills and death against many mobs, rewarding players for reaching certain milestones. == Interface == {{/UI}} == Mechanics == The '''Bestiary''' tracks the kills of {{Green|360}} mobs across SkyBlock. Each mob has a family, with some families containing multiple mobs or mob variants. To start tracking Bestiary kills, it is required to talk to {{NPCSprite|Bramass Beastslayer}} on {{Zone|Spiders Den}} first. === Kill Credit === Bestiary credit is awarded when the player assists in killing a mob. Mobs found in [[Dungeons]] and the [[Kuudra]] boss fight have shared bestiary credit for players in the same instance. The following mobs have shared bestiary credit within the player's dungeon party: *[[Lost Adventurer]] *[[Angry Archaeologist]] *[[Shadow Assassin]] *[[King Midas]] *[[Mimic]] *[[Wither Miner]] *[[Wither Husk]] *[[Wither Guard]] *[[Terracotta]] *[[Woke Golem]] If a player is considered the owner of a mob, such as a [[Sea Creature]] they fished up, they will always receive credit, whether they dealt damage to the mob or not. === Brackets === Each family has a certain bracket tier, which determines the number of kills needed to earn [[#Leveling Rewards|Leveling Rewards]] in the family. Kill scaling per tier is standardized into brackets, where different tiers require different amounts of kills to earn leveling rewards. {| class="wikitable centertext" |- |+Cumulative Kill Brackets rewards are earned after reaching each milestone in a family and provide bonus stats and perks for the family and {{SBXP}}. |-|Default= {{Bestiary Rewards Table|rewards=Default|max_tier=25|bracket=1}} |-|Garden= {{Bestiary Rewards Table|rewards=Garden|max_tier=15|bracket=6}} |-|Hunting= {{Bestiary Rewards Table|rewards=Hunting|max_tier=10|bracket=Hunting 1}} === Milestone Rewards === Milestone rewards are obtained after reaching {{Green|10}} family milestones. Each milestone grants {{stat|hp|+1}}. Every {{Green|5}} milestones grant increasing amounts of {{Skill|Combat|XP}}. And every {{Green|10}} milestones grant {{SBXP|+10}}. Rewards are stored until the player claims them, and can accumulate to allow the player to claim multiple milestone rewards at once. The Combat XP is not affected by {{Stat|Combat Wisdom}}, it however is affected by all Pet Exp boosts.{{confirm}} {| class="wikitable ct" |+Combat XP Rewards !Milestone !XP |- |{{Romnum|V}} |{{DarkAqua|5,000}} |- |{{Romnum|X}} |{{DarkAqua|10,000}} |- |{{Romnum|XV}} |{{DarkAqua|20,000}} |- |{{Romnum|XX}} |{{DarkAqua|30,000}} |- |{{Romnum|XXV}} |{{DarkAqua|45,000}} |- |{{Romnum|XXX}} |{{DarkAqua|50,000}} |- |{{Romnum|XXXV}} |{{DarkAqua|65,000}} |- |{{Romnum|XL}} |{{DarkAqua|80,000}} |- |{{Romnum|XLV}} |{{DarkAqua|100,000}} |- |{{Romnum|L}} |{{DarkAqua|125,000}} |- |{{Romnum|LV}} |{{DarkAqua|150,000}} |- |{{Romnum|LX}} |{{DarkAqua|175,000}} |- |{{Romnum|LXV}} |{{DarkAqua|200,000}} |- |{{Romnum|LXX}} |{{DarkAqua|250,000}} |- |{{Romnum|LXXV}} |{{DarkAqua|300,000}} |- |{{Romnum|LXXX}} |{{DarkAqua|350,000}} |- |{{Romnum|LXXXV}} |{{DarkAqua|400,000}} |- |{{Romnum|XC}} |{{DarkAqua|500,000}} |- |{{Romnum|XCV}} |{{DarkAqua|750,000}} |- |{{Romnum|C}}+ |{{DarkAqua|1,000,000}} |} == Families == {{/List}} == Trivia == * Due to its absence in internal tracking, the following mobs were not tracked before the '''Bestiary''' revamp: [[Kuudra#Mobs|Kuudra Mobs]], [[Bal]], and [[Reindrake]]. Additionally, the stats of {{Lv|1}} [[Cow]], [[Chicken]], [[Sheep]], [[Pig]], and [[Zombie]] were merged into their minion counterparts and therefore do not count for Bestiary credit. * If the player has not moved their camera in the past hour, they will not receive Bestiary credit for any mob kills.{{confirm}} == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2026/Oct 15|Changed formula for {{Stat|strength}} and {{Stat|magic find}} from \lfloor 0.1 \times ({\color{lime}\text{Tier}}+7.5)^2-5.025 \rfloor to 3 \times \color{lime}\text{Tier}.
So it now gives more {{Stat|strength}} and {{Stat|magic find}} at lower tiers, equal at {{Green|Tier XV (15)}}, and less at higher tiers}} |beta= {{History|0.11.2|Added '''Bestiary'''.}} {{History|0.19.2|Revamped '''Bestiary'''.|Bonus coins per kill for each bestiary mob tier now work correctly.|Bonus XP orbs per kill for each bestiary mob tier have been heavily increased.|[[Magic Find]] per bestiary mob tier has been rescaled.}} {{History|2023/Aug 15|Fixed sometimes not being able to gain Combat EXP and Bestiary progress from killing mobs with abilities from weapons such as Hyperion.}} {{History|2026/Aug 4|Reduced bestiaries for many mobs.}} {{History|2026/Aug 11|Reduced the kills required for some Hunting Tiers. *'''Hunting 1''': {{Green|1, 10, 25, 50, 75, 100, 150, 200, 250, 300}} {{To}} {{Green|1, 5, 10, 20, 35, 50, 65, 85, 105, 125}} *'''Hunting 2''': {{Green|1, 10, 20, 30, 45, 60, 80, 100, 125, 150}} {{To}} {{Green|1, 5, 10, 15, 25, 40, 55, 70, 85, 100}}}} {{History|2026/Aug 19|Changed Hunting Bestiaries to grant additional {{Skill|Hunting|XP}} instead of additional {{Coins}}.}} {{History|2026/Aug 24|Fixed several Critter Bestiaries awarding [[Magic Find]] instead of [[Hunting Fortune]].|Fixed several [[Lotus Atoll]] Critters using incorrect '''Bestiary''' brackets.}} {{History|0.27.1|The [[Shiny Pig]] '''Bestiary''' entry now displays Year of the Pig loot.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Lore}} [[Category:Mechanics]] [[Category:Combat]]
